name: 投研团队铸造舰
description: 投研团队铸造舰的舰队模板：三岗错峰（巡检 08:30 / 设计 08:37 / 拍板 08:44）——巡检岗只读盘点本主名下每支投研团队的在岗情况与市场漂移；设计岗按缺口出模板蓝图草稿与现役编制草案并跑既有校验链干跑；拍板岗把已确认的变更做成提案送拍板队列。三岗都只到草稿与提案：巡检零写面、设计无批准铸造发布权、提案权只在拍板岗。
notes: 三岗错峰 08:30 / 08:37 / 08:44（Asia/Shanghai，与既有投研舰队窗口不重叠）。写面只到草稿与提案；上架与铸造是外向动作，由主人批准后走操作者通道。依赖 invest-team-forge-roles。三支柱断言本版为 rubric 过渡形态（form=transitional），引擎结构断言已落地，可择机升级。

en.name: Investment Research Team Forge
en.description: Fleet template for building and maintaining investment-research teams: a scout that inventories every team under this owner plus market drift, a designer that drafts template blueprints and live rosters against the existing validation chain, and a decider that turns confirmed gaps into proposals. All three stop at drafts and proposals — the scout has no write surface, the designer cannot approve, cast or publish, and only the decider may propose.
en.notes: Three posts staggered 08:30 / 08:37 / 08:44 (Asia/Shanghai). Writes stop at drafts and proposals; publishing and casting are outward actions done by the owner through the operator channel. Depends on invest-team-forge-roles. Pillar assertions are the rubric transitional form here.
